# Project overview

This project explores infant habituation through looking times using a large harmonised dataset from ManyBabies 1, ManyBabies 3, and ManyBabies 4. It is part of a multi-team data analysis effort. The overall project is led by Ingmar Visser, and study-relevant materials are available on the [Open Science Framework](https://osf.io/8xm4r).
